@ChapterJuni asked me for my bread recipe, and that was the push i needed to post for the first time. Hello!

Basic Bread Ingredients

  • 1 cup water (very warm but not hot enough to burn)

  • 2.5 cups flour (plus extra for kneading)

  • 1/4 tsp. yeast

  • 1 tsp. salt

  • (Optional: 1 tsp. sugar)

This recipe is really forgiving, and you can make it fit your schedule.

Add water and yeast to bowl. Stir. Wait at least 5 minutes.
Add flour and combine. Wait 20 minutes to several hours and knead however you like.
Let dough rise for an hour or more (all day is an option) Grease whatever you are making it in. (I use a covered enameled dish) Knead again, and put dough in the baking dish. Let it sit awhile (5min to 2 hours) Preheat the oven to 400-450. Your oven may vary.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, until solid. You can test this by thumping the top and what sound it makes.

Notes: More time and more kneading yields more yeast activity for a fluffier bread. Working the dough can substitute for making this bread much quicker. Although wait times are what I usually do, you can have this bread ready to go into the oven in an hour, or even 20 minutes. Or you can give the dough all day. Your choice.
Covering in the oven yields a softer crust, uncovered is crispier.
I use the same recipe for pizza dough, but much more quickly (20 min – 1 hour for the dough)
